'''Sentient of the Sidereal''' was a title awarded by the periodical [[Chrono (periodical)/Legends|''Chrono'']].<ref name="HoloNet News ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/194_1.gif|text=Chrono}}</ref>

''Chrono'' named [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] "[[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]] of the Sidereal" just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HoloNet News ad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Since the term "[[Wikipedia:Orbital period|sidereal period]]" in astronomy is defined as the time that it takes an object to make one full orbit around its sun, relative to the surrounding stars — in other words, a planet's local "year" — the term "Sentient of the Sidereal" essentially means "Person of the Year." The American news magazine [[Wikipedia:Time (magazine)|''Time'']] — the title of which translates to "chronos" in Greek — publishes an annual "[[Wikipedia:Time Person of the Year|Person of the Year]]" issue.
